content:
Reddit has just reported another strong set of quarterly results and even secured a place in the S&P 500, yet the stock chart tells a very different story. Investors who held Reddit over the past year are down 33.3%, including dividends. If an investor had bought in on 29 October 2025 believing machine translation, AI search, and higher margins justified a rich P/E, what did that original case miss or underweight?

The easy part of this move is behind Reddit. Zero in on 30 high quality undervalued stocks for companies trading below our estimates.

The Argument Reddit Investors Were Actually Having

The shares cost US$211 at the start of the period, and buyers were essentially choosing between an aggressive AI-led expansion story and a regulatory overhang story.

The bullish Reddit case used a Fair Value of US$235, the price those upbeat assumptions pointed to, anchored in projected revenue growth of 43.7% a year and profit margins rising toward 29.6% over three years.

The cautious view pinned Fair Value at US$129 and leaned on the risk that tighter global privacy rules and heavier moderation demands would lift compliance costs and restrict data monetization over time.

What The Results Changed For Reddit

Reddit's Q2 2026 figures showed revenue of US$804.9 million and net income of US$252.8 million, with net margin at 31.4% compared with 17.9% a year earlier. That improvement in profitability leaned toward the bullish case that expected higher margins, while slowing user growth and search traffic volatility from Google kept the regulatory and platform-risk concerns alive. Overall, the evidence cut both ways.

The hinge assumption was that AI tools and international rollouts would translate into durable monetization, not just user buzz. For a different stock, you would track whether rising ad tools, data deals or new formats show up in revenue per user and net margin within a year of the story investors are paying for.

What Reddit's Drop Asks You To Believe Today

Reddit now trades at US$130. The selected Narrative argues its Fair Value sits above that level and treats the gap as a prompt to re-check the thesis rather than a simple green light.

The core question for you is whether the recent fall reflects a fixable dispute over traffic and licensing. Any buyer today would need to believe Reddit can manage the Google standoff without permanently damaging user growth or data economics.

"Reddit is reportedly considering cutting off Google's access to its content for AI training, an aggressive escalation in stalled licensing negotiations. Resolved badly, Reddit risks losing search traffic and licensing revenue in the same move."

Company 2 - 43% below our estimate - converts a swelling backlog of data center builds into recurring infrastructure management services.

Company 3 - 36% below our estimate - wins complex subsea projects that pair faster tiebacks with dependable services revenue streams.

chineseContent:
Reddit 刚刚公布了另一组强劲的季度业绩，甚至在标准普尔 500 指数中占有一席之地，但股票图表却讲述了一个截然不同的故事。过去一年持有 Reddit 的投资者减少了 33.3%，其中包括股息。如果投资者在 2025 年 10 月 29 日买入，相信机器翻译、人工智能搜索和更高的利润率证明了较高的市盈率是合理的，那么最初的案例错过了什么或低估了什么？

这一举措最简单的部分是在 Reddit 背后。交易价格低于我们预期的 30 只优质被低估股票为零。

Reddit 投资者实际上的争论

该股在本期初的价格为 211 美元，买家基本上是在人工智能主导的激进扩张故事和监管悬而未决的故事之间做出选择。

看涨的 Reddit 案例使用的公允价值为 235 美元，即这些乐观假设所指出的价格，其基础是预计每年收入增长 43.7%，利润率在三年内升至 29.6%。

谨慎的观点将公允价值固定在 129 美元，并倾向于认为随着时间的推移，更严格的全球隐私规则和更严格的审核要求将提高合规成本并限制数据货币化。

Reddit 结果发生了什么变化

Reddit 的 2026 年第二季度数据显示，营收为 8.049 亿美元，净利润为 2.528 亿美元，净利润率为 31.4%，而去年同期为 17.9%。盈利能力的改善倾向于预期利润率更高的乐观情况，而谷歌的用户增长放缓和搜索流量波动使监管和平台风险担忧持续存在。总体而言，证据是双向的。

关键假设是人工智能工具和国际推广将转化为持久的货币化，而不仅仅是用户的热议。对于不同的股票，您可以跟踪不断增长的广告工具、数据交易或新格式是否会在投资者为之付费的一年内体现在每用户收入和净利润中。

今天 Reddit 的 Drop 要求你相信什么

Reddit 现在的交易价格为 130 美元。选定的叙述认为其公允价值高于该水平，并将这一差距视为重新检查论文的提示，而不是简单的绿灯。

您面临的核心问题是，最近的下跌是否反映出流量和许可方面的可解决争议。如今，任何买家都需要相信 Reddit 能够应对谷歌的僵局，而不会永久损害用户增长或数据经济。

“据报道，Reddit 正在考虑切断谷歌对其人工智能培训内容的访问，这是陷入僵局的许可谈判的激进升级。如果解决得不好，Reddit 可能会因此失去搜索流量和许可收入。”
